description: Source code for CyclicBuffer class implementation, managing a circular buffer with synchronization, locking, and reading/writing operations.

classes.name: CyclicBuffer
classes.description: Implementation of a thread-safe cyclic buffer with synchronization, reservation, locking, and read/write operations.

methods.name: Open
methods.description: Loads the buffer and initializes internal pointers.

methods.name: Close
methods.description: Destroys the buffer and resets internal pointers.

methods.name: SignalLock
methods.description: Waits for a signal with a timeout.

methods.name: DataAvailable
methods.description: Virtual method called when data becomes available.

methods.name: Reevaluate
methods.description: Reevaluates the buffer state and signals waiters.

methods.name: Alert
methods.description: Sets an alert and reevaluates buffer state.

methods.name: Read
methods.description: Reads data from the buffer into provided buffer.

methods.name: Write
methods.description: Writes data into the buffer from provided buffer.

methods.name: AssureFreeSpace
methods.description: Ensures there is enough free space for a write.

methods.name: Reserve
methods.description: Reserves space in the buffer for writing.

methods.name: Lock
methods.description: Locks the buffer for exclusive access.

methods.name: Peek
methods.description: Peeks at data without removing it.
